run_random_agent_episode: run a random agent episode in a DeepMind Hard Eight task environment using Docker
create_random_agent: create a RandomAgent that samples random actions from the environment action spec
run_random_agent_act: run the RandomAgent act method to generate a random action dictionary from action specs
configure_environment_settings: configure DeepMind Hard Eight environment settings with a seed and level name
load_environment_from_docker: load a DeepMind Hard Eight environment from a Docker image with given settings
